    AI Overview
    Two Boozers play for the Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team as of the 2025–2026 season: twins Cameron Boozer (forward) and Cayden Boozer (guard). They are the sons of former Duke star and NBA All-Star Carlos Boozer and are both five-star recruits who joined the team as freshmen in 2025. 
    Cameron Boozer: A 6-foot-9 forward ranked as a top prospect, known as a strong scorer and rebounder. 
    Cayden Boozer: A 6-foot-4 point guard, known for his floor leadership. 
    They led Columbus High School to four consecutive state championships before joining Duke, continuing their father's legacy at the university.
